premise: Maya never stops to sit, so Leo has the printer print a bench facing the Earth — and when she finally sits down, she waves at home.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Ant and the Grasshopper', turned: even the busiest ant needs a bench, and a friend who builds one.
lesson: Resting is part of the work too.

en-US.title: A Bench for Two
en-US.text: {woman:enter} Maya never sat still. Rocks to collect! Buggies to drive! Panels to clean! {woman:hop x2} {man:enter} Leo watched her bounce past for the hundredth time. {man:face happy} He had an idea. He loped over to the {printer:enter} printer {man:go to printer} and tapped in a plan. {man:pulse} {printer:live} {sfx:whirr} Whirr… layer. Whirr… layer. All day, the printer worked, while Maya rushed about. By evening there was something new on the plain: a bench made of moon soil, facing the Earth. {printer:sparkle} {man:says} [warmly] “Maya! Sit down for one minute.” {woman:face surprised} {woman:says} [rushed] “Sit? I haven't got time to sit!” {woman:wobble} But she sat. Just for one minute. {woman:face happy} [softly] And from the bench, there was the Earth, round and blue over the ridge. Her family was down there, somewhere. {woman:live hold} Maya waved, and kept her hand up for a long, long time. {man:hearts} {man:says} [whispers] “Told you.” [softly] {woman:hearts} After that, Maya sat on the bench every day. For one minute. Or two.

es-ES.title: Un banco para dos
es-ES.text: {woman:enter} Maya nunca se estaba quieta. ¡Rocas que recoger! ¡Buggies que conducir! ¡Paneles que limpiar! {woman:hop x2} {man:enter} Leo la vio pasar dando botes por centésima vez. {man:face happy} Se le ocurrió una idea. Fue dando saltos hasta la {printer:enter} impresora {man:go to printer} y tecleó un plan. {man:pulse} {printer:live} {sfx:whirr} Zzzum… capa. Zzzum… capa. La impresora trabajó todo el día, mientras Maya corría sin parar. Por la tarde había algo nuevo en la llanura: un banco de tierra lunar, mirando a la Tierra. {printer:sparkle} {man:says} [warmly] «¡Maya! Siéntate un minuto.» {woman:face surprised} {woman:says} [rushed] «¿Sentarme? ¡No tengo tiempo de sentarme!» {woman:wobble} Pero se sentó. Solo un minuto. {woman:face happy} [softly] Y desde el banco se veía la Tierra, redonda y azul sobre las montañas. Su familia estaba allí, en algún sitio. {woman:live hold} Maya saludó con la mano, y la dejó en alto mucho, mucho rato. {man:hearts} {man:says} [whispers] «Te lo dije.» [softly] {woman:hearts} Desde entonces, Maya se sentaba en el banco todos los días. Un minuto. O dos.
